en.challenges_title: Rwandan Farmers Lose Crops Every Season
en.challenges_desc: Smallholder farmers produce 80% of Rwanda's food, but face critical challenges that threaten their livelihoods.
en.challenge_1_desc: Farmers often discover crop diseases too late, after significant damage has already occurred. Without early warning systems, entire harvests can be lost.
en.challenge_2_desc: Rwanda has only ~200 agronomists for 2+ million farmers. Most smallholders cannot reach a qualified expert when their crops get sick.
en.challenge_3_desc: Farmers rely on neighbor advice or shop recommendations, often buying wrong or banned pesticides that waste money and harm the environment.
en.challenge_4_desc: Most agricultural apps are in English only. Rwanda's farmers need solutions in Kinyarwanda to be truly accessible and effective.
en.before_after_desc: Hover over each card to see the transformation.

en.how_it_works_title: Three Simple Steps to Crop Health
en.how_it_works_desc: From diagnosis to treatment in seconds — no agronomist needed for initial assessment.
en.step_1_desc: Open the AgroAssist AI app and simply point your phone camera at any sick or unusual-looking leaf, stem, or fruit. Our AI is trained to work with any phone camera — even in cloudy weather or low light. No special equipment needed, just your phone and a diseased crop. Whether you're in your garden or deep in the field, one tap is all it takes to start the diagnosis.
en.step_2_desc: In less than 30 seconds, our AI engine analyzes your photo and identifies the exact disease affecting your crop — complete with the disease name, how severe it is, and how confident the AI is in its diagnosis. It covers over 50 crop diseases across tomato, potato, maize, rice, coffee, and more. No waiting for an agronomist. No guessing. Just fast, accurate answers right on your screen.
en.step_3_desc: Once the disease is identified, AgroAssist AI recommends the best treatment options — including Rwanda-approved pesticides with exact dosage, how to apply them, and where to buy them locally in your district. You also get safety intervals for harvesting, so your produce stays safe for consumption. Everything is available in both English and Kinyarwanda, so you never miss a detail.
en.impact_m_desc: Success is measured in farmer outcomes — not just features shipped.
en.impact_m_1_desc: Early blight detection stops total harvest failure before it spreads.
en.impact_m_2_desc: Right pesticide + weather check = zero wasted sprays.
en.impact_m_3_desc: Market data removes middleman exploitation at sale.
en.impact_m_4_desc: From waiting weeks for an agronomist to an instant AI answer.
en.impact_m_5_desc: Offline mode queues and syncs — no data lost in rural fields.
en.features_title: Everything Farmers Need in One App
en.features_desc: From AI-powered diagnosis to expert consultations, AgroAssist AI is a complete agricultural intelligence platform.
en.feature_1_desc: Take a photo of any diseased crop and get instant diagnosis with disease name, severity percentage, and confidence score. Our AI identifies 50+ diseases across tomato, potato, maize, rice, coffee, and more.
en.feature_2_desc: Only recommends RICA/RAB-registered agrochemicals with exact dosage, active ingredients, and safety class.
en.feature_3_desc: Scans queue locally and sync when internet returns. Built for Rwanda's rural connectivity challenges.
en.feature_4_desc: Full bilingual support with one-tap language toggle. Every screen, every message in your language.
en.feature_5_desc: Connect directly with certified agronomists in your district for personalized advice on complex cases.
en.feature_6_desc: GPS-based weather data with spray advisory (safe/unsafe to spray) and 3-day forecast for your location.
en.feature_7_desc: AI-powered real-time crop market prices for Rwanda. Know what your harvest is worth before you sell.
en.feature_8_desc: Export branded diagnostic certificates with full disease analysis, treatment plan, and expert recommendations.
en.feature_9_desc: Live voice conversation with an AI agronomist. Designed for accessibility — works even for visually impaired farmers.
en.impact_desc: Across all 30 districts of Rwanda, AgroAssist AI is empowering farmers with the intelligence they need to thrive.
en.impact_1_desc: Expanding across all 5 provinces of Rwanda
en.impact_quote: "AgroAssist AI gives me the confidence to treat my crops properly. Before, I had to walk 2 hours to find an agronomist. Now I just take a photo and get answers in seconds."
en.mission_p1: When a farmer sees a diseased leaf, the clock starts. In Rwanda, getting a proper diagnosis means traveling hours to find an agronomist — and waiting days or even weeks for an answer. By then, the disease has spread, the damage is done, and the harvest is lost. Every season, smallholder farmers lose up to 30% of their crops to preventable diseases, simply because help comes too late.
en.mission_p2: AgroAssist AI changes that. We deliver a professional-grade diagnosis in under 30 seconds — right from a farmer's phone. That single shift from weeks to seconds is the foundation of everything we do. But speed alone isn't enough. We believe every smallholder farmer deserves the same agricultural intelligence that large commercial farms take for granted — whether they speak English or Kinyarwanda, and whether they have internet access or not.
en.mission_p3: Our mission is clear: make expert-level crop diagnosis free, instant, and accessible to every farming family across Rwanda — so no farmer has to lose a season because help was too far away.
en.team_title: Meet the People Behind AgroAssist AI
en.team_desc: A passionate team of engineers, agronomists, and business leaders building the future of farming in Rwanda.
en.download_desc: Download AgroAssist AI for free. Available as Android APK and Progressive Web App. Works on any smartphone.
en.partners_desc: We're proud to work with organizations that share our vision for transforming African agriculture.
en.footer_desc: AI-powered crop disease diagnosis platform for Rwandan smallholder farmers. Building the future of agriculture, one scan at a time.
en.footer_copyright: © 2026 AgroAssist AI. All rights reserved. Built in Rwanda for African farmers.

rw.step_3_desc: Igihe indwara yamenyekanye, AgroAssist AI yereka ubuvuzi bwiza — harimo imiti yemewe y'Urwanda hamwe n'ibiro bya nyayo, uko yakoreshejwe, aho igurishwa mu karere kawe. Ufite nanone igihe kizewe gushyiraho. Ibintu vyose biri mu Kinyarwanda n'icyongereza, kugira ngo utangurwe ibintu.
